Name: Carryable Chests
Author: cylixlee
Description:
[size=6]Carryable Chests[/size]

Stardew Valley mod for picking up and moving chests without emptying them first.

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/CarryableChests/img/cover.png[/img]

[size=5][b]How To Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Right-click a placed chest to open it as usual.[/*]
[*]Left-click a chest with empty hands to pick it up.[/*]
[*]Right-click while holding a chest to open it.[/*]
[*]Place the chest like any other item.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]

This mod provides the following settings in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url].

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/CarryableChests/img/settings.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Maximum Reach[/b][/size]

How far away a chest can be picked up from. Defaults to `1`.

[size=4][b]Require Empty Hands[/b][/size]

Whether your hands must be empty before picking up a chest. Defaults to enabled.

[size=4][b]Open Held Chest[/b][/size]

Whether right-click opens the chest you're carrying. Defaults to enabled.

[size=4][b]Return On Save[/b][/size]

Whether carried chests are put back into the world before saving. Defaults to disabled.

[size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Only the host can pick up or place carried chests in multiplayer for now.

[size=5][b]Limitations[/b][/size]

Only normal player chests are supported right now.

[size=5][b]Contributing[/b][/size]

The source code is at my [url=https://github.com/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods]GitHub repo[/url].
